checked_scope: The known-Gram projection estimator, its conditional confidence ellipsoid, and the doubly robust remainder bound.
checks: For independently selected fixed basis and supplied positive Gram G, variance in prediction norm<=A^2 E[bprime G^-1 b]/n=A^2 K/n. Conditional-on-training Markov gives radius A sqrt(K/(n eta)) at realized dimension without a union over dimensions.

Doubly robust response remainder equals(ehat-e)[(m1hat-m1)/ehat+(m0hat-m0)/(1-ehat)]. Its coefficient displacement is an L2 orthogonal projection, with G-norm<=||R||2; Holder L4 product bound introduces no sqrt(K).

Almost-sure realized training certificate is required for almost-sure conditional coverage. Merely high-probability nuisance rates give unconditional coverage after paying training failure; supplied population Gram is not empirical-Gram control and projection coverage is not full-CATE coverage.
